additivity_note: recipient sets intersect across contracts and across chains, so recipient counts are NOT additive and no cross-chain recipient total is reported; contract and campaign counts are additive, volume shares are not
campaign_qualifier: a campaign is counted when ANY of its contracts qualifies: an upper count of campaign involvement and a lower count of campaign-wide fabrication. The qualifier must accompany the number.
criterion: a broadcast transfer whose named sender is a registry-verified token; the assertion is established as fabricated by contract state, and the criterion identifies rows making it

ledger_intersection.note: every contract emitting a criterion row is one the ledger test positively establishes, so the event-level share is nested inside the contract-state result rather than merely adjacent to it. When the nesting is complete the row figure is exact, not apportioned: all criterion rows are emitted by confirmed contracts by construction.
